[SWS_PER_00493]
d
When
ara::per::FileStorage::GetCurrentFileSize
is
called for an existing
file
,
Persistency
shall return the current size of the passed
file
. This size shall reflect only the data contained in the
file
. In case the
file
is
currently open,
Persistency
shall return the current size of the
file
, which might
differ from the size of the
file
in the
storage
if the last changes are not yet synchro-
nized. Otherwise, if the
file
is not open,
Persistency
shall return the size of any
